content: Speak words that are pleasing and sweet; why speak harsh words when gentle words are freely available, like eating raw unripe fruit when ripe sweet fruit is right at hand?
author: Thiruvalluvar
explanation: Harsh speech poisons relationships and agitates the speaker's own mind. Choosing pleasant, truth-filled words nourishes mutual trust and peace.
practicalInsight: Before speaking in moments of frustration today, filter your sentence: is it true, is it necessary, and is it framed constructively?
reflectionPrompt: Why do I sometimes choose bitter words when sweet and truthful ones are available?
